key_reasoning.reason: Four production components changed: the catalog-driven model resolver (claude.models.ts: applyContextWindow, keepConfiguredModel, replaceRetiredModel, picker options), the Claude beforeRun lifecycle hook (claude.plugin.ts: new resolution reasons and warning branches), the statusline bundle (suffix-tolerant router and label lookups), and the shared LlmModel type (sso.http-client.ts: max_input_tokens). The pattern is clear, but the change crosses the resolver, plugin hook and statusline consumer and touches a shared catalog type.

7 files changed (3 production files plus the statusline, and 3 test files), 639 insertions and 93 deletions, all under src/agents/plugins/claude and src/providers/plugins/sso. Diffstat count of 7 maps to L; roughly 60% of the added lines are tests.
